title: The Open Wreck
author: Oscar Okonkwo
blurb: Zephyrine Yarrow, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
